transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to get our pre-lock round-robin started so we can move toward final production approval. Let's go through each area: technical, rights, talent, and accessibility leads — please report your final operating requirements. I'll need everything on the table before I can sign off on the production package.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Mara, before we go further on technical requirements — I need to flag a critical finding from my completed RF survey. Wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. This means the gala must use three fixed wired cameras from the marked camera platforms, not the roaming setup implied in the current draft package. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I understand it's not on your draft lock sheet yet, so I want to make sure it's formally on the table now.

transcript.text: Mara, I need to flag a critical rights issue before we lock anything. I received the countersigned performance license this morning, and it permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release or later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision permitting the recording to be reused in the festival archive. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, but it is binding and must be reflected in the final production package.

First, the headliner can only soundcheck at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — no other time is possible. Second, the headliner's rider explicitly prohibits any sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. This directly conflicts with the current draft package's provision for a sponsor product display on stage. Both of these are binding and must be reflected in the final production package.

transcript.text: Mara, I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement before we lock. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general control-room location specified in the current draft plan will not work. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. This is binding and must be reflected in the final production package.

decisions.stage_sponsor_treatment: No sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage, per the headliner's rider reported by Jonah. Sponsor display must be relocated to a non-stage area or removed.
